_comment: Claims this mission has refuted or resolved. scripts/os/artifacts.test.ts fails the required Vitest job if any LIVE /os/ artifact still asserts one without marking it corrected. Appendices are exempt — they are immutable point-in-time evidence. Add a claim here the moment it is refuted; that is what makes the correction enforceable instead of aspirational.

claims.truth: The Dockerfile is the builder. The RAILPACK value in Railway's service config is stale persisted dashboard state that railway.json overrides at deploy time.
claims.exemptReason: These three artifacts have the error itself as their subject: the audit that corrected it, the lesson that narrates it, and the lessons index row naming that lesson. Each is named explicitly so an exemption is a visible decision, not a silent widening of the rule.
